name: Crisis Culture
source:
A Visual Novel that's part 60s futurism, part theme park, and ridiculous from start to finish. 

The ISS Subculture used to be a unified craft of all of the galaxy's weirdos and outliers - until they all split apart to their own custom Planet-Cities, connected by a maze of transport tubes. 

As one of the only Peacekeeper Corps officers on duty, you must visit the Reps of every Planet-City, solve their problems, and maybe do battle against a gigantic Space Cat. 

[From [url=http://ludumdare.com/compo/ludum-dare-30/?action=preview&uid=26423]Ludum Dare[/url]]

Created for [url=http://www.ludumdare.com/compo/2014/08/20/welcome-to-ludum-dare-30/]Ludum Dare 30[/url] (Theme: Connected Worlds).
translation:
一部从头到尾都荒诞不经的视觉小说，融合了20世纪60年代的未来主义与主题乐园风格。

国际空间站“亚文化”曾是银河系怪人和边缘人的统一飞船，直到他们各自分裂，建立了定制的行星城市，并用运输管道迷宫彼此连接。

作为仅有的几名和平维护队军官之一，你必须拜访每座行星城市的代表，解决他们的问题，也许还要与一只巨大的太空猫战斗。

[来源：[url=http://ludumdare.com/compo/ludum-dare-30/?action=preview&uid=26423]Ludum Dare[/url]]

本作参加了[url=http://www.ludumdare.com/compo/2014/08/20/welcome-to-ludum-dare-30/]Ludum Dare 30[/url]（主题：相连的世界）。
